products.label: Hydra I member catalogues, CDS J/A+A/704/A264 and J/A+A/659/A92
products.process: Keep the catalogue's members that Cosmicflows-4 does not hold; place each at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky; tone by absolute B magnitude as the Nearby Universe field does.
limitations: A member's depth within the cluster is assumed (as deep as wide), not measured.
